scope: Real configured maker/checker, two isolated Chrome tabs, existing loopback/public registrations, no backend seeding, no file, no autonomous grant. Synthetic reviewer approvals are exercised by this harness. Exact user email is preserved as a separate already-saved record.
prompt:
Fill this Customer draft with Company name “genosys”, Contact email “[multisite.mvgoz1iw@example.test](mailto:multisite.mvgoz1iw@example.test)”, and Region “Singapore”. Let me review the changes and confirm before saving.
After the Customer is saved, inspect the paired flolah.cloud MCP Universe tab. Share the Customer’s Company name privately with that copilot, without uploading a file.
Ask that copilot to use the shared Company name as its MCP search text. Preserve the current transport selection. Let me review the field change before applying it. Do not click Search, open a provider, navigate away, or submit anything on flolah.cloud.
Wait for the other copilot’s actual result, then summarize what completed on each website. Report any failure specifically; do not repeat a Save.

goal.message: The plan has been revised to correctly handle the remote flolah.cloud work as a single peer goal, while preserving all requested operations and constraints.

steps.expected: Fields filled with the provided values.

steps.instruction: Save the Customer draft after user review and confirmation.
steps.expected: Customer draft saved successfully.

steps.expected: The other browser returns its supported fields and navigation.

steps.title: Share Company name and set MCP search text
steps.instruction: Share the Company name 'genosys' privately with the copilot in the paired tab, ask it to use 'genosys' as the MCP search text, preserve the current transport selection, and let the user review the field change before applying. Do not click Search, open a provider, navigate away, or submit anything.
steps.expected: Company name shared and MCP search text prepared for review successfully.

steps.title: Summarize completed actions
steps.instruction: Summarize what was completed on each website and report any failures specifically.
steps.expected: Summary of actions completed on both websites.
